newsitem.title: JAPAN: JR firms seek 1.94 pct fare rise from April 1.
newsitem.headline: JR firms seek 1.94 pct fare rise from April 1.

text.p: East Japan Railway Co (JR East) and West Japan Railway Co (JR West) said they and four other companies in the Japan Railways group applied to the Transport Ministry on Wednesday for an average 1.94 percent fare increase from April 1.
The application was made to cope with a planned increase in the consumption tax, spokesmen for the two companies said.
The two firms believe the fare increase would have no impact on their earnings, the spokesmen said.
The fare rise is expected to cost JR East 3.3 billion yen to implement and JR West about 1.1 billion yen, as they need to adjust ticketing machines and other equipment, the spokesmen said.
The government plans to increase the consumption tax to five percent from three percent on April 1.
